correos.ayuda: Add an address and enter the 8-digit code we send to confirm it. Each code allows 5 attempts and expires at the time shown. We only send notifications to the address marked “Gets notifications”. You choose which notifications you get on this same page, under email notifications. To remove the address that gets notifications, first choose another one.
correos.error_carga: We could not load your email addresses. Select “Try again”. If it keeps failing, contact IT.
correos.vacio: You have no email address yet. Add one to get notifications.

correos.exito_reenviar_repetido: We already sent a new code to {direccion}. Check your inbox.

imagen.ayuda: Choose how you appear at the top right of the screen: with your initials, an icon or a photo of yourself, on the colour you prefer. The photo is optional and, for now, only you can see it. When you save it, we crop it to a square, make it smaller and remove the hidden data in the file, such as where and when it was taken. If you change or remove your photo, the previous one is deleted. JPG, PNG or WebP photos up to 20 MB are accepted.
